title: Medical-Surgical Supply Percentage — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Contract schedule.** The medical-surgical supply percentage applied to the revenue code 0270 supply charges (apart from the listed saline flush A4216) of an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing):

| Payer class and account class | Percentage applied |
|---|---|
| Commercial HMO Claim for an Observation Stay Account | 0.3 (30%) |
| Commercial PPO Claim for an Observation Stay Account | 0.38 (38%) |
| otherwise | the payer class's expected allowed percentage of charges |

Example (hypothetical): supply charges of 500.00 → 150.00 on a Commercial HMO Claim for an Observation Stay Account, 190.00 on a Commercial PPO Claim for an Observation Stay Account; on an Emergency Department Visit Account the expected allowed percentage applies.
